checks.detail: Both reviewed files parse as JSON at the recorded byte counts and SHA-256 identities. Provenance binds the exact oracle and all six active schema hashes, records NOT_COMPARED, and records no product comparison.

Oracle author infinium.public-oracle-author/cedar-meridian differs from the reviewer identity. Authored and corrected timestamps precede this review, and no comparison occurred before review acceptance.

Source and candidate execution inputs and retained producer transcripts use the exact active closed schema shapes, types, identifiers, prompt bindings, and proposal tokens. Expected axes and decisions remain outside the answer-free execution inputs.

All six source producer results leave local applicability not evaluated. The three source cases requiring consumer support or applicability bind neutral analysis-run consumer inputs with exact proposal, subject, scope, source, decision-link, raw-fact byte-count, and SHA-256 identities.

Every extracted source proposition equals its bound retained passage. The contradicted case resolves one distinct available 94-byte opposition statement whose SHA-256 recomputes exactly, and its contradiction-bearing transcript contains exactly one proposal as required by the active schema.

Candidate contexts and proposals bind exact candidate, hypothesis, context, source, application, and evidence identities. Supporting, insufficient, directly opposing, unavailable, and explicitly indeterminate cases are independently derivable from the bounded structured inputs.

Only supported/applicable is admitted. Explicit abstention is abstained/not-evaluated/not-evaluated/abstained; unavailable material abstains and is never audit-only; deliberate deletion is deleted/unavailable/not-evaluated/audit-only; structural and policy failures reject with both semantic axes not evaluated.

The five support states cross the five applicability states in exactly 25 unique cells. Supported/applicable alone admits and all other ordinary semantic cells abstain; rejection and deletion retention remain explicit matrix exceptions.

Each of the eleven retained source or candidate proposals has exactly one unique consumer decision link. Exact structured invalid inputs contain respectively zero and two links, and all structural and policy mutations bind exact JSON pointers, old values, replacement values, and full package identities.
